dialogues.speaker: Jacquetta
dialogues.text: I don't get it. Don't those two leaders sit in the same office — in fact, don't they sit at adjoining tables? Why are their views different?

dialogues.speaker: Isadora
dialogues.text: It might be a communication issue...

dialogues.speaker: Jacquetta
dialogues.text: And every time I try to get a signature, if they aren't both missing, then one will ask me to get a second opinion from the other. I mean, would it kill them to get their story straight first!?

dialogues.speaker: Isadora
dialogues.text: Then maybe they don't have a good relationship...

dialogues.speaker: Jacquetta
dialogues.text: There's been a lot of work to do regarding rebuilding and repairing the flood damage lately.

dialogues.speaker: Jacquetta
dialogues.text: The excitement of not having been dissolved didn't last long, and now a pile of other problems have surfaced that need to be dealt with...
